thread:
maria_cs: Heads up — Horizon Finance submitted a model onboarding request for a small multi-model pipeline (summarizer + reranker + sentiment classifier). They require private deployment (VPC), HSM for keys, PHI in data, and tight latency SLAs. Want to kickoff next week; flagged as high priority for renewal. Any immediate blockers?

sanjay_se: Thanks Maria. Do we have sample data + target QPS/latency? Which model sizes/families are they expecting?

maria_cs: Quick intake summary from them: PHI allowed, expected peak ~200 QPS, 99th pct latency targets — summarizer <300ms, reranker <600ms, end-to-end <900ms. Prefer open models: summarizer ~13B, reranker ~7B, sentiment tiny classifier. They'll share sample dataset after NDA.

linda_ml: We'll need safety + PHI tokenization checks before any private deploy. Recommend Dedicated for predictable perf at 200 QPS. Also need eval harness and prompt templates from the customer. Ask them for a 1-2k sample and a few representative prompt/response pairs.

owen_eng: Infra notes: HSM + VPC on Private is doable but for HSM in certain regions they'll need on-prem or a region with HSM support. For an initial pilot, Dedicated in us-west with a fallback policy sounds safest. Also need customer-managed certs and allowed IP ranges.

sanjay_se: I'm creating the CS intake ticket and onboarding checklist now. @linda_ml can you own safety evals? @owen_eng can you scope infra + provisioning? I'll coordinate enablement and flag renewal risk in CRM.

deploy-bot: Ticket created — CS-9876: Horizon Finance multi-model onboarding (private + HSM + PHI).

maria_cs: They want a pilot in ~3 weeks. They explicitly said renewal may depend on pilot timing (Q2). Can we realistically meet that if they turn around NDA + sample data quickly?

linda_ml: 3 weeks is tight but doable if: (1) we get dataset + prompt templates today, (2) no custom finetuning required, and (3) model artifacts are HF repos or standard checkpoints. Safety eval ETA ~4 days once data arrives; perf bench ~5 days on Dedicated test pool. We'll prioritize.

owen_eng: I'll provision a Dedicated test pool today and wire up a staging VPC. Need model artifact links (HF repo or .pt) and sample payloads. Upload instructions for the customer: `scp sample.jsonl cs_upload@redwood:/incoming/horizon/`

maria_cs: Also sending them a short checklist and NDA now. I'll request: sample (1-2k records), prompt templates, expected traffic shape, and any custom tokenization rules.

sanjay_se: I'll set a weekly sync with the customer and add a high renewal-risk tag in Salesforce. @vikram_sre please keep an eye on network & storage quotas for perf runs.

vikram_sre: On it — add me to CS-9876. I'll monitor egress and GPU utilization during benchmarks.

linda_ml: Quick config example I'll use for perf bench (internal):
```json
{
  "pipeline": ["13B-sum", "7B-rerank", "tiny-sentiment"],
  "batching": {"max_tokens": 1024, "strategy": "latency"},
  "quant": "int8",
  "hsm_integrated": true
}
```

om: small typo note: will run bench with sequences 256/512/1024 to match their use cases.

maria_cs: Great — I'll push the checklist + NDA now. Customer asked for a kickoff slot next Tue — I'll propose Tue morning PT.

sanjay_se: Perfect. Keep thread updated. Thx all :thumbsup:
